name: Cascais, Portugal

visa.notes: D7 visa requires proof of passive income. NHR ended Jan 2024; IFICI replacement excludes pensions.

rent.notes: Cascais municipality had the highest asking rent in the Lisbon district at 24.58 EUR/m2/month (Aug 2026 observatory); a 85-95 m2 T2 implies ~2,100-2,300, matching a 90-100 m2 T2 estimate of 1,800-2,050 at 20.5 EUR/m2 (May 2026) and a live Imovirtual T2 sample (Cascais e Estoril, 121 listings) with 1,300-2,500 common and luxury outliers to 9,000.

groceries.notes: Two adults at 220-350 EUR per person per month (Lisbon-area 2026 guide; Cascais supermarkets price like Lisbon or slightly above) plus ~85-95 EUR/month large-breed kibble for a 100 lb dog (Royal Canin Maxi Adult 15 kg at 82-104 EUR). Food CPI 3.7% y/y Oct 2026.

utilities.notes: Electricity ~70-80 for a 2-3BR with electric heating and light A/C (regulated-market couple benchmark 37.77/month at 1,900 kWh, Oct 2026), gas ~25-30 (unverified estimate), Aguas de Cascais 2026: 9.64 fixed + 0.65/0.97 per m3 in tiers 1-2, i.e. ~18 for 10 m3 of water before sanitation and waste, so ~35 all-in (ERSAR national average 34.65); a 25% cut to tiers 1-2 was approved Jul 2026. Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Legal residents register with the SNS at no premium (primary care free since 2022). Private top-up cover that expat retirees typically carry: a couple in their 60s on standard Medis/Multicare/Fidelidade plans pays about 250-350 EUR/month total (Sep 2026 guide); hospital-only plans for two are around 120; premium tiers 180-280 per person. Premiums rose ~10% in 2026.

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (stored 140 was health cover; health cost now fully in healthcare). Tenant contents (recheio) policy for 30k EUR incl. seismic cover costs 44-77 EUR/year in Lisbon per DECO Sep 2026 test (Allianz Casa Base 43.58, ok! casa Completo 76.52); max allows tenant-liability add-on.

sources.title: Melhor seguro casa para inquilinos (DECO Proteste, 11 Sep 2026)

petCare.notes: Routine vet consults 30-45 EUR, annual vaccines 25-50 EUR (2026 guide; average dog upkeep 1,021 EUR/yr all-in), plus flea/tick/heartworm preventives dosed for a 100 lb dog (~35-45/month) and one extra visit or bloodwork a year. Food excluded.

sources.title: Animais de estimacao em Portugal: guia completo 2026 (Ricavida)

petDaycare.notes: Cascais daycare/boarding quotes 15-25 EUR per day (Fixando Q3 2026 median 20, up from 15 in Q1); occasional use of ~6-8 days a month or one boarding week a quarter gives ~150.

sources.title: Preco de hotel e creche para animais em Cascais (Fixando)

petGrooming.notes: Bath and grooming quotes average 38-43 EUR (range 30-60) in the Lisbon market; a large double-coated dog sits at the top of that range, groomed every 6-8 weeks.

sources.title: Preco de banhos e tosquias para animais em Lisboa (Fixando)

transportation.notes: One lightly used car (~500 km/month at 7 L/100 km, gasoline 95 at 2.03 EUR/L on 1 Nov 2026 ~70; insurance ~29 on a 344 EUR/yr national average; maintenance ~35; IUC ~12) plus occasional Navegante use (~20). Navegante Metropolitano is 40 EUR/month per person, frozen for 2026; Navegante +65 is 20 EUR once they reach 65.

sources.title: Gasoleo mais caro que gasolina novembro 2026 (simula.pt, DGEG averages)

entertainment.notes: 1 Gbps fibre 15-35 EUR (Digi/UZO/WOO 10-15, MEO 29.99, Vodafone 31, NOS 35, Jul 2026), streaming ~30, dining out for two 4 times a month at ~55 EUR mid-range (Numbeo Lisbon Nov 2026; Cascais slightly higher), plus cinema (8.50), gym (42) or similar activities.

clothing.notes: Modeled basket for two retirees from Numbeo Nov 2026 item prices (jeans 92, chain-store dress 40, running shoes 92, men's leather shoes 108): a few mid-range items per person per quarter.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Lisbon, Nov 2026 (Numbeo)

phoneCell.notes: Two local lines: low-cost brands (Digi, UZO, WOO, Amigo) 5-7 EUR each for 100 GB/unlimited; main brands MEO/NOS/Vodafone 13-20 EUR unlimited (Jul 2026). Typical assumes two main-brand plans; max allows keeping one US number (e.g. Google Fi) alongside.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: SNS taxas moderadoras now apply only to unreferred hospital emergencies; primary care, scheduled consultations and exams are free. Out-of-pocket is mainly private-side (CUF Cascais, Hospital da Luz): GP 50-100, specialist 80-180, dental check 40-90, blood panel 60-150 (2026), reduced to 15-25 EUR copays in insurer networks.

sources.title: Vai as urgencias sem passar pelo SNS 24 - taxas moderadoras (Postal, Aug 2026)

healthcare.system: SNS public healthcare plus excellent private clinics. Easy access to Lisbon hospitals (30 min).
healthcare.waitTimes: Moderate (3-6 weeks for specialists); fast private options nearby
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Standard SNS coverage with co-pays; private insurance widely used

pros: Upscale beach town with excellent quality of life

stateIncomeTax.exemptions: NHR ended Jan 2024 (IFICI replacement excludes pensions). Foreign pensions/retirement income taxed at standard progressive rates 12.5-48%. US-Portugal treaty provides foreign tax credit.

taxes.notes: NHR ended Jan 2024. IFICI replacement excludes pensions. Standard progressive rates 14.5%-48%.
